answer: Every identity splits a ferrous tally: the public half goes on file, the private half stays key-bound. The public halves form a spiral ledger anyone can replay; one key holding many is a farm. Each epoch a falcon calls a tenth; each called identity must show its matching half; a rented half burns the bond. 1,000 fakes lock 45,000 plus 6 each per epoch: 105,000 in ten epochs against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its share.
